rows.name: EADaily
rows.attributionSource: ANCOM（羅馬尼亞通訊監管機關），依 EU Council Regulation 833/2014 Annex XV
rows.evidenceSummary: ANCOM 將 EADaily/Eurasia Daily列為 EU 禁止傳播內容的俄國相關媒體名單之一。Evidence: https://www.ancom.ro/en/about-us/media-en/press-releases/the-broadcasting-of-content-produced-by-certain-media-channels-is-prohibited-in-the-european-union/
rows.scaleDescription: EADaily 自述為 2015 年成立的 Eurasia Daily 通訊社，在歐亞經濟聯盟、烏克蘭、喬治亞、阿布哈茲、南奧塞提亞與德涅斯特河沿岸有記者/分析員；本清單按區域歐亞事務入口處理。規模資料來源：EADaily About。

rows.name: Fondsk / Фонд стратегической культуры
rows.evidenceSummary: ANCOM 依 EU Annex XV 列名 Fondsk；OFAC 指 Strategic Culture Foundation 為 SVR-directed/controlled online journal。Evidence: https://www.ancom.ro/en/about-us/media-en/press-releases/the-broadcasting-of-content-produced-by-certain-media-channels-is-prohibited-in-the-european-union/ ; https://home.treasury.gov/news/press-releases/jy0126
rows.scaleDescription: OFAC 指其為 SVR 指導、與俄外交部密切關聯的 online journal；Factcheck.bg 查到其文本被保加利亞媒體大量翻譯轉載，單篇曾逾百萬觀看，影響力主要來自內容洗稿與跨站轉載。規模資料來源：OFAC；Factcheck.bg。

rows.name: Izvestia / Известия
rows.attributionSource: ANCOM，依 EU Council Regulation 833/2014 Annex XV
rows.evidenceSummary: ANCOM 將 Izvestija 列為 EU 禁止傳播內容的俄國相關媒體名單之一。Evidence: https://www.ancom.ro/en/about-us/media-en/press-releases/the-broadcasting-of-content-produced-by-certain-media-channels-is-prohibited-in-the-european-union/
rows.scaleDescription: Eurotopics 估網站每月 20-30M visits、紙本發行量約 83,500；屬 National Media Group 旗下，2017 年整合三個 TV station 與線上/紙本 newsroom。規模資料來源：Eurotopics。

rows.name: Katehon

rows.scaleDescription: EU/EAO 指 Katehon 被 EU 暫停在歐盟的 broadcasting license；GEC 報告將其描述為五語網站，主要向歐洲受眾提供貌似獨立的分析材料。規模資料來源：EU/European Audiovisual Observatory；U.S. State Department GEC report。
rows.urlCheck: HTTP 307（反機器/重新導向；URL 解析有效）

rows.name: Lenta.ru
rows.evidenceSummary: ANCOM 依 EU Annex XV 列名 Lenta；Moldova SIS 將 lenta.ru 列入會改變資訊空間、應封鎖的線上來源清單。Evidence: https://www.ancom.ro/en/about-us/media-en/press-releases/the-broadcasting-of-content-produced-by-certain-media-channels-is-prohibited-in-the-european-union/ ; https://sis.md/ro/content/31-de-site-uri-care-altereaz%C4%83-spa%C8%9Biul-informa%C8%9Bional-urmeaz%C4%83-fi-blocate
rows.scaleDescription: DFRLab 將 Lenta 納入 14 個代表性俄語親克里姆林媒體來源之一；歷史資料顯示其 2012 年每日訪客曾超過 600,000，屬俄語大型線上新聞站。規模資料來源：Atlantic Council/DFRLab；Lenta.ru profile。

rows.name: New Eastern Outlook
rows.evidenceSummary: OFAC 指 New Eastern Outlook 為 SVR-directed disinformation outlet；ANCOM 亦依 EU Annex XV 列名。Evidence: https://home.treasury.gov/news/press-releases/jy0628 ; https://www.ancom.ro/en/about-us/media-en/press-releases/the-broadcasting-of-content-produced-by-certain-media-channels-is-prohibited-in-the-european-union/
rows.scaleDescription: OFAC 將 NEO 列為 SVR-directed disinformation outlet；EU 亦於後續制裁中暫停其在歐盟傳播活動，影響力屬俄情報導向 proxy outlet 而非大眾流量型媒體。規模資料來源：OFAC；EU/EAO。

rows.name: NewsFront
rows.evidenceSummary: OFAC 指 NewsFront 為 Crimea-based disinformation and propaganda outlet，並稱其為 FSB behalf/controlled；ANCOM 亦依 EU Annex XV 列名。Evidence: https://home.treasury.gov/news/press-releases/jy0126 ; https://home.treasury.gov/news/press-releases/jy0628 ; https://www.ancom.ro/en/about-us/media-en/press-releases/the-broadcasting-of-content-produced-by-certain-media-channels-is-prohibited-in-the-european-union/
rows.scaleDescription: OFAC 指 NewsFront 是克里米亞基地的 disinformation/progaganda outlet，面向西方受眾提供所謂替代資訊，並聚焦支持俄方在烏克蘭的代理勢力。規模資料來源：OFAC。

rows.name: Oriental Review
rows.evidenceSummary: OFAC 指 Oriental Review 為 SVR-directed disinformation outlet；ANCOM 亦依 EU Annex XV 列名。Evidence: https://home.treasury.gov/news/press-releases/jy0628 ; https://www.ancom.ro/en/about-us/media-en/press-releases/the-broadcasting-of-content-produced-by-certain-media-channels-is-prohibited-in-the-european-union/
rows.scaleDescription: OFAC 將 Oriental Review 列為 SVR-directed disinformation outlet；EU 後續暫停其在歐盟傳播活動，影響力定位為 proxy analysis/commentary outlet。規模資料來源：OFAC；EU/EAO。

rows.name: RIA Novosti / РИА Новости
rows.englishName: RIA Novosti / Russian News Agency Novosti
rows.attributionSource: ANCOM，依 EU Council Regulation 833/2014 Annex XV
rows.evidenceSummary: ANCOM 將 RIA Novosti 列為 EU 禁止傳播內容的俄國相關媒體名單之一。Evidence: https://www.ancom.ro/en/about-us/media-en/press-releases/the-broadcasting-of-content-produced-by-certain-media-channels-is-prohibited-in-the-european-union/
rows.scaleDescription: Rossiya Segodnya 自稱 RIA Novosti 是俄國 leading news agency，RIA.RU 月獨立訪客逾 127M；Eurotopics 估每月 20-30M visits。規模資料來源：Rossiya Segodnya；Eurotopics。

rows.name: RuBaltic
rows.attributionSource: ANCOM，依 EU Council Regulation 833/2014 Annex XV
rows.evidenceSummary: ANCOM 將 RuBaltic 列為 EU 禁止傳播內容的俄國相關媒體名單之一。Evidence: https://www.ancom.ro/en/about-us/media-en/press-releases/the-broadcasting-of-content-produced-by-certain-media-channels-is-prohibited-in-the-european-union/
rows.scaleDescription: 其影響力主要來自俄語波羅的海議題定位；EU 將 RuBaltic 納入被暫停傳播的 Kremlin-backed disinformation outlets 名單。規模資料來源：EU Council sanctions Q&A；ANCOM/EU Annex XV。

rows.name: Rossiyskaya Gazeta / Российская газета
rows.evidenceSummary: ANCOM 依 EU Annex XV 列名 Rossiiskaja Gazeta；Moldova SIS 也將 rg.ru 列入封鎖清單。Evidence: https://www.ancom.ro/en/about-us/media-en/press-releases/the-broadcasting-of-content-produced-by-certain-media-channels-is-prohibited-in-the-european-union/ ; https://sis.md/ro/content/31-de-site-uri-care-altereaz%C4%83-spa%C8%9Biul-informa%C8%9Bional-urmeaz%C4%83-fi-blocate
rows.scaleDescription: Rossiyskaya Gazeta 是俄國政府出版的官方報紙，負責刊登法律、總統令與政府文件；DFRLab 將其納入 14 個代表性俄語親克里姆林媒體來源。規模資料來源：Rossiyskaya Gazeta profile；Atlantic Council/DFRLab。
rows.urlCheck: HTTP 401（站方拒絕自動化請求；URL 解析有效）

rows.name: SouthFront
rows.evidenceSummary: OFAC 指 SouthFront 是 receiving taskings from the FSB 的 online disinformation site；ANCOM 亦依 EU Annex XV 列名。Evidence: https://home.treasury.gov/news/press-releases/jy0126 ; https://home.treasury.gov/news/press-releases/jy0628 ; https://www.ancom.ro/en/about-us/media-en/press-releases/the-broadcasting-of-content-produced-by-certain-media-channels-is-prohibited-in-the-european-union/
rows.scaleDescription: OFAC 指 SouthFront 接收 FSB tasking，受眾包括軍事迷、退伍軍人與陰謀論社群；影響力偏向英文軍事/地緣敘事社群。規模資料來源：OFAC。

rows.targetRegion: 俄國/多區域（含中亞語言版）
rows.name: Sputnik / Спутник
rows.evidenceSummary: ANCOM 依 EU Annex XV 列名 Sputnik and subsidiaries；Moldova SIS 將多個 Sputnik 網域列入發布影響國家安全之虛假資訊來源；Latvia VDD 稱 Sputnik/Baltnews 為俄國國有 Rossiya Segodnya 的資訊資源。Evidence: https://www.ancom.ro/en/about-us/media-en/press-releases/the-broadcasting-of-content-produced-by-certain-media-channels-is-prohibited-in-the-european-union/ ; https://sis.md/ro/content/5-site-uri-care-public%C4%83-informa%C5%A3ii-false-%C3%AEn-domeniul-ce-afecteaz%C4%83-securitatea-na%C8%9Bional%C4%83 ; https://vdd.gov.lv/en/news/press-releases/vdd-detains-latvian-citizen-for-cooperation-with-kremlin-propaganda-resource-subjected-to-sanctions
rows.scaleDescription: Rossiya Segodnya 自述 Sputnik 網站/頻道有 34 種語言並在多國設辦公室；國務院 GEC 將 RT/Sputnik 定位為俄國 state-funded global messaging 核心節點。規模資料來源：Rossiya Segodnya；U.S. State Department GEC。

rows.name: InfoRos
rows.evidenceSummary: OFAC 指 InfoRos 主要由 GRU 72nd Main Intelligence Information Center 運作，並用網站網路散布 GRU promoted disinformation。Evidence: https://home.treasury.gov/news/press-releases/jy0126 ; https://home.treasury.gov/news/press-releases/jy0628
rows.scaleDescription: OFAC 指 InfoRos 以「news agency」自稱，但主要由 GRU 72nd Main Intelligence Information Center 運作，並透過網站網路散布 GRU-promoted disinformation。規模資料來源：OFAC。

rows.name: Rhythm of Eurasia
rows.evidenceSummary: OFAC 指 Rhythm of Eurasia 為 Strategic Culture Foundation affiliate，並因代表/支援 SCF 被指定。Evidence: https://home.treasury.gov/news/press-releases/jy0628
rows.scaleDescription: OFAC 將 Rhythm of Eurasia 列為 Strategic Culture Foundation affiliate；影響力主要是 SCF/SVR proxy ecosystem 內的歐亞議題節點。規模資料來源：OFAC。

rows.name: Journal Kamerton
rows.evidenceSummary: OFAC 指 SVR 與 SCF 推動 Journal Kamerton，並稱其刊載貶低烏克蘭的文章。Evidence: https://home.treasury.gov/news/press-releases/jy0628
rows.scaleDescription: OFAC 指 SVR 與 SCF 推動 Journal Kamerton，並將其列為 SCF affiliates；影響力屬情報導向 proxy publishing network 的附屬節點。規模資料來源：OFAC。

rows.name: United World International
rows.evidenceSummary: OFAC 指 UWI 由 Prigozhin 所屬 Project Lakhta 建立，並因代表/受其控制被指定。Evidence: https://home.treasury.gov/news/press-releases/jy0628
rows.scaleDescription: OFAC 指 UWI 由 Prigozhin 所屬 Project Lakhta 在 2020 年建立；Project Lakhta 是面向美國、歐洲、烏克蘭與俄國的影響行動。規模資料來源：OFAC。

rows.name: Geopolitica
rows.evidenceSummary: OFAC 指 Geopolitica 由 Alexander Dugin 控制，作為俄國極端民族主義者向西方及其他受眾散布 disinformation and propaganda 的平台。Evidence: https://home.treasury.gov/news/press-releases/jy0628
rows.scaleDescription: OFAC 指 Geopolitica 由 Alexander Dugin 控制，作為俄國極端民族主義者向西方與其他受眾散布 disinformation and propaganda 的平台。規模資料來源：OFAC。

rows.evidenceSummary: Moldova SIS 將 kp.md 與 kp.ru 列入會改變資訊空間、應封鎖的線上來源清單；本列依去重規則只保留主站 kp.ru。Evidence: https://sis.md/ro/content/31-de-site-uri-care-altereaz%C4%83-spa%C8%9Biul-informa%C8%9Bional-urmeaz%C4%83-fi-blocate

rows.name: TASS / ТАСС
rows.evidenceSummary: DFRLab 將 TASS 納入俄語親克里姆林媒體生態的代表來源並分析其戰爭敘事；EANA 指 TASS 因俄國媒體監管環境而無法提供 unbiased news，暫停其會員資格。Evidence: https://www.atlanticcouncil.org/wp-content/uploads/2023/02/Narrative-Warfare-Final.pdf ; https://newsalliance.org/news/the-european-alliance-of-news-agencies-eana-suspends-tass-from-alliance-pending-exclusion-decision
rows.scaleDescription: State Media Monitor 指 TASS 為俄國 flagship state news service，約 70 個俄國/CIS bureau、近 60 個海外辦公室、每日近 3,000 則新聞；DFRLab 亦納入代表性俄語媒體樣本。規模資料來源：State Media Monitor；Atlantic Council/DFRLab。

rows.scaleDescription: DFRLab 將 REGNUM 納入 14 個代表性俄語親克里姆林媒體來源，並在 2021-12-16 至 2022-02-24 的 Event Registry 研究中納入其完整發布輸出。規模資料來源：Atlantic Council/DFRLab。

rows.name: Gazeta.ru / Газета.Ru
rows.evidenceSummary: DFRLab 將 Gazeta.ru 納入俄語親克里姆林媒體生態代表來源；Eurotopics 指 Gazeta.ru 現已 aligned with the Kremlin，政治取向為 pro-government。Evidence: https://www.atlanticcouncil.org/wp-content/uploads/2023/02/Narrative-Warfare-Final.pdf ; https://www.eurotopics.net/en/169480/gazeta-ru
rows.scaleDescription: Eurotopics 估 Gazeta.ru 每月 40-50M visits，並稱其曾是俄國重要獨立新聞網站、現已 aligned with the Kremlin；DFRLab 亦納入代表性俄語媒體樣本。規模資料來源：Eurotopics；Atlantic Council/DFRLab。
rows.urlCheck: HTTP 200 -> SSO gate；可見 RSS 已停在 2024-03，未作監測

rows.name: Vzglyad / Взгляд
rows.evidenceSummary: DFRLab 將 Vzglyad 納入俄語親克里姆林媒體生態代表來源；Eurotopics 指其由與 Kremlin 關係密切的機構出版，政治取向為 pro-government。Evidence: https://www.atlanticcouncil.org/wp-content/uploads/2023/02/Narrative-Warfare-Final.pdf ; https://www.eurotopics.net/en/186483/vzglyad
rows.scaleDescription: Eurotopics 估 Vzglyad 每月 10-20M visits，受眾聚焦商界與行政官員，出版方與 Kremlin 關係密切；DFRLab 亦納入代表性俄語媒體樣本。規模資料來源：Eurotopics；Atlantic Council/DFRLab。
rows.urlCheck: HTTP 200；RSS HTTP 200，最舊列 2026-05-09，需另建 historical profile

rows.name: BelTA / БелТА
rows.evidenceSummary: AidData 將 BelTA 列為白俄國家媒體所有權與外國影響渠道的一部分；State Media Monitor 指 BelTA 為政府控制的國家通訊社；iSANS 將 BelTA 納入白俄宣傳媒體景觀。Evidence: https://www.aiddata.org/publications/belarus-profile-of-media-ownership-and-potential-foreign-influence-channels ; https://statemediamonitor.com/2025/08/belta/ ; https://isans.org/wp-content/uploads/2023/01/from-fortress-2-rhetoric-to-the-rhetoric-of-war_changes-in-by-propaganda_isans-report_nov2022_eng-1.pdf
rows.scaleDescription: State Media Monitor 指 BelTA 是白俄 state-owned national news agency，並有 7 Days、Belruskaya Dumka、Economy of Belarus 等 print assets；AidData 將白俄媒體所有權結構列為俄國影響渠道分析對象。規模資料來源：State Media Monitor；AidData。
rows.urlCheck: HTTP 200；RSS 可用性不穩，另建 all_news profile

rows.scaleDescription: AidData 將 Sovetskaya Belorussiya - Belarus Segodnya 列為白俄 print 類最受消費媒體第 1 名，並記錄其由白俄政府持有。規模資料來源：AidData。
rows.urlCheck: HTTP 200；profile HTTP 200，分頁對自動化回傳 403，需保留 incomplete backlog state

rows.name: Voice of Europe
rows.evidenceSummary: Czech MFA 稱 Viktor Medvedchuk 使用 Voice of Europe media platform 執行 Russian influence operation；ANCOM 亦依 EU Annex XV 列名。Evidence: https://mzv.gov.cz/jnp/en/issues_and_press/press_releases/eu_puts_voice_of_europe_and_two_other.html ; https://www.ancom.ro/en/about-us/media-en/press-releases/the-broadcasting-of-content-produced-by-certain-media-channels-is-prohibited-in-the-european-union/
rows.scaleDescription: Czech MFA 指 Medvedchuk 使用 Voice of Europe media platform 執行俄國影響行動；公開調查描述其影響範圍延伸到歐洲議會與多國政界人士。規模資料來源：Czech MFA；European Pravda/Reuters reporting。

rows.name: News-Pravda / Portal Kombat network
rows.chineseName: News-Pravda／Portal Kombat 親俄宣傳網路
rows.evidenceSummary: VIGINUM 將 Portal Kombat 描述為結構化、協調的親俄宣傳網路，至少 193 個入口站；本列只保留主站，pravda-fr/de/pl/es/en 等語言版未另列。Evidence: https://www.sgdsn.gouv.fr/publications/portal-kombat-un-reseau-structure-et-coordonne-de-propagande-prorusse
rows.scaleDescription: France SGDSN/VIGINUM 指 Portal Kombat 至少 193 個站點，2022 年後轉向佔領區與支持烏克蘭的西方國家；後續研究指出 Pravda network 以高產量內容干擾搜尋與 LLM 資訊環境。規模資料來源：VIGINUM/SGDSN；ISD/Guardian reporting。

rows.name: Baltnews
rows.evidenceSummary: Latvia VDD 稱 Baltnews/Sputnik 為俄國國有 Rossiya Segodnya 的資訊資源，受 Kremlin control 並 disseminates narratives in line with Kremlin interests。Evidence: https://vdd.gov.lv/en/news/press-releases/vdd-detains-latvian-citizen-for-cooperation-with-kremlin-propaganda-resource-subjected-to-sanctions
rows.scaleDescription: Rossiya Segodnya 將 Baltnews 列為集團品牌；Latvia VDD 指 Baltnews/Sputnik 為 Rossiya Segodnya 資訊資源，受 Kremlin control 並散布符合 Kremlin 利益的敘事。規模資料來源：Rossiya Segodnya；Latvia VDD。

rows.name: Aeronet / AE News
rows.attributionSource: Czech Ministry of Interior, Centre Against Hybrid Threats (CTHH)
rows.evidenceSummary: Czech MoI/CTHH 在監測俄國侵烏後的捷克 quasi-media/pro-Kremlin scene 時，以 Aeronet 文章作為散布相關敘事的例子。Evidence: https://mv.gov.cz/volby/clanek/jak-kvazi-medialni-scena-reflektovala-invazi-vojsk-ruske-federace-na-ukrajinu-a-sirila-propagandu-kremlu-v-monitorovanem-obdobi-od-24-unora-do-23-dubna.aspx
rows.scaleDescription: 捷克/斯洛伐克研究將 Aeronet 列為捷克親俄 campaign 主要來源之一；學術研究指出此類 Czech disinformation ecosystem 多屬 fringe/alternative online news projects，整體觸及較有限。規模資料來源：Czech/Slovak disinformation research；Springer chapter。
rows.urlCheck: HTTP 307（站方反機器/重新導向；URL 解析有效）

rows.name: Nová republika
rows.evidenceSummary: Czech MoI/CTHH 指 Nová republika 在監測期間出現大量使用/轉載 Kremlin rhetoric 的文字內容。Evidence: https://mv.gov.cz/volby/clanek/jak-kvazi-medialni-scena-reflektovala-invazi-vojsk-ruske-federace-na-ukrajinu-a-sirila-propagandu-kremlu-v-monitorovanem-obdobi-od-24-unora-do-23-dubna.aspx
rows.scaleDescription: Voxpot/The Insider 將 Nová republika 列為捷克 disinformation websites 的 key players 之一；該群體總流量約 18M visits/月，並在選前月產量上升。規模資料來源：Voxpot via The Insider；Czech MoI/CTHH。

rows.name: AC24
rows.evidenceSummary: Czech MoI/CTHH 指 AC24 在監測期間出現使用/轉載 Kremlin rhetoric 的文字內容，並列入捷克 quasi-media/pro-Kremlin scene 觀察。Evidence: https://mv.gov.cz/volby/clanek/jak-kvazi-medialni-scena-reflektovala-invazi-vojsk-ruske-federace-na-ukrajinu-a-sirila-propagandu-kremlu-v-monitorovanem-obdobi-od-24-unora-do-23-dubna.aspx
rows.scaleDescription: Masaryk University 曾將 AC24 納入四個捷克親克里姆林網站研究；Voxpot/The Insider 指 AC24 曾是俄國材料進入捷克語環境的主要翻譯/放大者之一。規模資料來源：Masaryk University；Voxpot via The Insider。

rows.name: CZ24.news
rows.evidenceSummary: DFRLab 指 CZ24.news 為散播受制裁克里姆林媒體內容的 disinformation aggregator；Insight News 指 CZ24 為捷克 pro-Kremlin disinformation portal。Evidence: https://dfrlab.org/2026/04/03/how-sputnik-czechias-successor-adapted-to-circumvent-sanctions/ ; https://insightnews.media/the-pro-kremlin-network-behind-czech-disinformation-portal-cz24/amp/
rows.scaleDescription: Insight News/RFE 指 CZ24 是捷克與斯洛伐克資訊空間最大 disinformation portals 之一，月流量可達數百萬，2025 年每月最高約 2,000 篇。規模資料來源：Insight News；RFE/Voxpot。
rows.urlCheck: HTTP 403（站方拒絕自動化請求；URL 解析有效）

rows.name: Parlamentní listy
rows.evidenceSummary: Masaryk University 研究將 Parlamentní listy 列為 disseminate pro-Kremlin propaganda 的捷克網站；Visegrad Insight 引用研究指出其在外交議題上的操弄技巧甚至比 Sputnik 更強。Evidence: https://www.em.muni.cz/en/science/7860-research-pro-kremlin-propaganda-in-the-czech-republic-employs-dishonest-journalistic-practices ; https://visegradinsight.eu/correction-on-czech-media-outlet-expanding-to-poland/
rows.scaleDescription: Masaryk University 指其被許多捷克政治人物視為標準媒體通道，且在研究中比 Sputnik 使用更多 manipulative techniques；Kremlin Watch 指 PL 每日捷語讀者曾高於 iHNED 或 Lidovky。規模資料來源：Masaryk University；European Values/Kremlin Watch reporting。

rows.name: Origo

rows.scaleDescription: Insight News 指 Origo 是 KESMA 旗下 prominent website，SimilarWeb 約 16M visits/月；匈牙利親俄網站總 views 約佔該國媒體網站 views 的 14%。規模資料來源：Insight News。

rows.name: Magyar Nemzet

rows.scaleDescription: Insight News 指 Magyar Nemzet 是 KESMA prominent website 之一，匈牙利親俄網站 views 中 Magyar Nemzet 約 8M/月。規模資料來源：Insight News。

rows.name: Pogled.info
rows.attributionSource: Center for the Study of Democracy；Factcheck.bg
rows.evidenceSummary: CSD 指 Pogled.info 是 Bulgaria pro-Kremlin online outlets 中的重要節點；Factcheck.bg 指 Pogled.info 轉譯/發布 Strategic Culture Foundation 等克里姆林資訊操作內容。Evidence: https://csd.eu/fileadmin/user_upload/publications_library/NED_Report_WEB.pdf ; https://factcheck.bg/en/this-is-the-kremlin-speaking-how-bulgarian-media-turn-into-megaphones-for-kremlin-propaganda/
rows.scaleDescription: Factcheck.bg 指 SCF 內容幾乎總是先進入 Pogled.info 再被其他保加利亞媒體轉載，並記錄單篇 Pogled.info 文章曾達 1.65M views。規模資料來源：Factcheck.bg。

rows.name: Blitz.bg
rows.attributionSource: Center for the Study of Democracy；CRTA/BFMI
rows.evidenceSummary: CSD 指 Blitz.bg 例行發布源自 Kremlin 的敘事與文章；CRTA/BFMI 報告將 Blitz 列為保加利亞 consistently publish pro-Kremlin disinformation 的 problem outlet。Evidence: https://csd.eu/fileadmin/user_upload/publications_library/files/2025_01/Webs_of_Deceit_Report.pdf ; https://crta.rs/wp-content/uploads/2023/12/CRTA_BFMI_Defunding_Disinformation_in_the_Balkans_Report.pdf
rows.scaleDescription: CSD/MCIFF 指 blitz.bg 是保加利亞最突出的 pro-Kremlin disinformation amplifier 之一，且屬保加利亞最高 organic traffic mainstream outlets 之一。規模資料來源：CSD/MCIFF；CSD NED report。

rows.scaleDescription: CSD/MCIFF 指 novosti.rs 是塞爾維亞最常被造訪新聞網站之一，同時是最突出的 pro-Kremlin disinformation amplifiers 之一。規模資料來源：CSD/MCIFF；CSD NED report。

rows.name: Hlavné správy
rows.attributionSource: iSANS；Slovak NBÚ/Defense Minister references in iSANS report
rows.evidenceSummary: iSANS 稱 Hlavné správy 是被 NBÚ 封鎖的 local online distributors of pro-Russian content 之一；並記載 Slovak Defense Minister 指其員工散布支持侵略國的宣傳，且涉俄使館付款。Evidence: https://isans.org/publications/how-they-shut-down-pro-russian-media-rubbish-in-slovakia.html
rows.scaleDescription: iSANS 指 Hlavné správy 等四站是斯洛伐克 four main local online distributors of pro-Russian content，且有相對 large audience；Insight News 另估其在匈牙利 Slovak minority 受眾中約 20,000 views/月。規模資料來源：iSANS；Insight News。

rows.name: Hlavný denník
rows.evidenceSummary: iSANS 稱 Hlavný denník 是 NBÚ 封鎖的四個主要 local online distributors of pro-Russian content 之一，並稱這些平台是 pro-Russian propaganda mouthpieces。Evidence: https://isans.org/publications/how-they-shut-down-pro-russian-media-rubbish-in-slovakia.html
rows.scaleDescription: iSANS 指 Hlavný denník 屬斯洛伐克 four main local online distributors of pro-Russian content，且有相對 large audience；影響力為本地語言替代媒體節點。規模資料來源：iSANS。

rows.name: InfoVojna
rows.evidenceSummary: iSANS 稱 InfoVojna 是 NBÚ 封鎖的四個主要 local online distributors of pro-Russian content 之一，並稱這些平台是 pro-Russian propaganda mouthpieces。Evidence: https://isans.org/publications/how-they-shut-down-pro-russian-media-rubbish-in-slovakia.html
rows.scaleDescription: iSANS 指 InfoVojna 屬斯洛伐克 four main local online distributors of pro-Russian content，且有相對 large audience；Insight News 另估其在匈牙利 Slovak minority 受眾中約 20,000 views/月。規模資料來源：iSANS；Insight News。

rows.name: Armádny magazín
rows.evidenceSummary: iSANS 稱 Armádny magazín 是 NBÚ 封鎖的四個主要 local online distributors of pro-Russian content 之一，並稱這些平台是 pro-Russian propaganda mouthpieces。Evidence: https://isans.org/publications/how-they-shut-down-pro-russian-media-rubbish-in-slovakia.html
rows.scaleDescription: iSANS 指 Armádny magazín 屬斯洛伐克 four main local online distributors of pro-Russian content；另一 iSANS 報告稱其 de facto 為 Hlavné správy 的組成部分。規模資料來源：iSANS。

rows.name: Niezależny Dziennik Polityczny
rows.attributionSource: Ukrinform Fact Check（烏克蘭國家通訊社查核欄）
rows.evidenceSummary: Ukrinform 指 Niezależny Dziennik Polityczny 是 fake Polish-language website，至少自 2020 年散布 Russian propaganda。Evidence: https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-factcheck/3906252-polish-fake-with-russian-roots-ukraine-creating-dirty-bomb-under-guise-of-building-nuclear-plant-in-cherkasy-region.html
rows.scaleDescription: Ukrinform 指其為假波蘭語網站，透過複製其他入口內容製造完整媒體外觀，並由俄媒與 Telegram 頻道主動轉傳；影響力偏向敘事種子與轉傳節點。規模資料來源：Ukrinform Fact Check。
